entities.name: RlmN
observations: Reviewed Geobacter RlmN homologs share 52–54% sequence identity with 97% query coverage to the supplied 344-aa sequence.
Curated homolog annotations describe methylation of adenine N2 at 23S rRNA position 2503 and tRNA position 37; query-specific activity remains a homology-based inference.
Homolog annotations report a [4Fe-4S] cluster and S-adenosyl-L-methionine involvement.

entities.name: RHEA:42916
observations: RlmN-type methylation of 23S rRNA adenosine 2503 to 2-methyladenosine; the retrieved equation includes two SAM molecules and reducing ferredoxin.
